name: Da Nang Cathedral
kicker: The pink church called the rooster church
summary: Look up at the pink church the city calls Con Ga, the rooster church, at 156 Tran Phu. It was built in 1923, nearly 70 meters, in a Gothic form, under Father Louis Vallet. From 1 January 2023 the parish sets visitors Monday to Saturday, 08:00 to 11:30 and 13:30 to 16:30. Sunday is not in that window. A fee is check on arrival.
getThere: 156 Tran Phu, on the parish about page. The 2015 tourism page prints no number. From the river, walk. From My Khe, take a Grab.
heroCaption: The pink facade and the rose window

notice.title: The rooster is not a French emblem
notice.body: An English tourism page calls the bird a French symbol. The Vietnamese parish page says the priest explains it as Peter in the Gospel, a call to wake up, not as France. The official parish name dates from 1963.

body: Give it the few minutes a church front takes, on a river morning. The city parish page says the church was built in 1923, nearly 70 meters high, under Father Louis Vallet, in a Gothic form with a rose window. Behind it is a grotto of Our Lady arranged after Lourdes. People in the city call it Con Gà, the rooster church, for the bird on the roof.

That page says the bird is Peter, not a symbol of France, and that from 1963 the parish’s official name is Nhà thờ giáo xứ Chánh tòa Đà Nẵng. The parish’s own notice of 28 December 2022, in force from 1 January 2023, sets visitors Monday to Saturday, 08:00 to 11:30 and 13:30 to 16:30, and asks for modest dress. Sunday is not in that window. The 2015 tourism page prints no timetable. The parish about page of 8 March 2014 prints 156 Trần Phú. A fee is still check on arrival. Do not copy a tour company’s window, and do not publish the old phone number on that about page.

figures.caption: The spire and the cross

gettingThere: The parish about page prints 156 Trần Phú. The 2015 tourism page does not. From a river hotel, walk to that street and ask for Nhà thờ Con Gà if the number has moved. From My Khe, take a Grab. Neither ride has a published minute count, so both stay check on arrival.

legs.heading: From the river
legs.body: Walk to 156 Trần Phú, the number on the 2014 parish page. Confirm the door.

legs.heading: From My Khe
legs.body: By Grab. The minutes are check on arrival.

hours: Monday to Saturday, 08:00–11:30 and 13:30–16:30, from the parish notice of 28 Dec 2022. Sunday is not in that visitor window. The 2015 tourism page prints no timetable.
closed: Sunday is not listed for visitors. No other closing day is published.
